definition: In theoretical computer science, a pattern language is a formal language that can be defined as the set of all particular instances of a string of constants and variables.
details: Pattern Languages were introduced by Dana Angluin in the context of machine learning.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. In plain words: In theoretical computer science, a pattern language is a formal language that can be defined as the set of all particular instances of a string of constants and variables. Here is how it actually plays out: Pattern Languages were introduced by Dana Angluin in the context of machine learning. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Pattern language (formal languages).
